cases.situation: Coworker keeps DMing me on Slack about his fantasy football league while I'm trying to finish a deck due at 4. Nice guy, don't want to be rude.
cases.reply: Ha, that trade is bold. I'm going heads-down on the board deck until 4, so I'll be quiet for a bit. Tell me how it plays out on Sunday.
cases.note: A real reason because you're cutting in mid-flow, and a forward hook instead of a question.

cases.situation: 友達と夜中までLINEしてて、もう寝たい。相手は恋愛の相談中で、まだ続きそうな雰囲気。
cases.reply: 話してくれてありがとう。ちゃんと聞きたいのに、もう頭が回らなくなってきた。続きは明日の夜、電話で聞かせてもらってもいい？今日はおやすみ。
cases.note: 重い話ほど「もう限界だから、ちゃんと聞ける時に」と正直に言うほうが、中途半端に返すより誠実です。

cases.situation: Told a guy from a dating app I'm heading to bed after he'd been texting me for two hours. He replied 'wow ok, guess I'm boring you'. I do like him.
cases.reply: Not a brush-off, I promise. I'm just done for the day and up at 6. Talk tomorrow.
cases.note: Give warmth without retracting the exit, and don't end on a question that restarts the thread.

cases.situation: 我妈每次打电话都能聊一个多小时，今晚我还得赶一个方案。想挂电话，又怕她觉得我嫌她烦。
cases.reply: 妈，我得挂了，今晚还有个方案要赶出来。挂之前跟您说一声，周六我回家吃饭，想吃您做的红烧肉。好啦，您早点休息，拜拜。
cases.note: 电话里先说要走，补一句最后的话，再说拜拜就挂，不用等她先挂，也不用反复道别。
